notes: No article received REDIRECT, NOINDEX, or RETIRE — the corpus has no content judged actively harmful or worthless, only duplicated (MERGE) or in need of evidence/currentness work (REFRESH). This reflects the actual quality distribution found, not a scoring artifact: RETIRE/REDIRECT/NOINDEX remain live options for any future re-audit that finds different evidence.

The needs_semantic_review majority (24 of 36 claims) is an explicit, intended output of this stage, not a gap: Stage 4's validators can check hash/reference/structural integrity but cannot themselves verify prose-level semantic accuracy against a claim's cited source. Each needs_semantic_review claim's recommended_action names what a human/Opus reviewer should check next.

The single blocking_finding (set-point-theory-why-body-resists-weight-loss) is why that article's disposition is REFRESH rather than KEEP even though nothing else about the article is disqualifying — see STAGE4_LEGACY_CORPUS_AUDIT.md section 5 for the specific claim.

P0 count (2) is deliberately small and specific to the two articles whose primary subject is prescription GLP-1/compounded-medication mechanics; other medication-adjacent articles (e.g. questions-to-ask-doctor-about-glp1-medications) were found KEEP-worthy because they make no specific drug-mechanism or efficacy claims of their own.

This file is a derived summary of the 34 per-article records and the cannibalization registry; scripts/validate-stage4-audit.ts recomputes these counts from the source-of-truth files and fails if this summary drifts from them.
